Submission Instructions

  1. Initialize a clean Git repository: git init scriptorium_workshop
  2. On the main branch, commit the base transcription text for the assigned excerpt from Athenaze / Greek Gospel of Mark.
  3. Create and checkout branch witness-alpha; introduce three scribal corrections / variants with clear commit messages.
  4. Create and checkout branch witness-beta from main; introduce two distinct variants and ensure text is normalized using Unicode NFC (unicodedata.normalize('NFC\, text)).
  5. Merge witness-alpha into main, then merge witness-beta into main, deliberately resolving the merge conflict in the editor.
  6. Generate your formatted graph log: git log --graph --oneline --all.
  7. Write a 300–500 word reflection addressing:
    • How does the Git commit graph document editorial deliberation compared to traditional apparatus notation?
    • Why is NFC normalization essential before attempting automatic text collation?
  8. Paste your formatted Git log and reflection into the submission box below.
